ashby:abacum:2ccea01f-9ece-4e54-8920-4be.summary:
Abacum is the AI-native business planning platform for scaling enterprises. We bring an organization's data, business logic, and business context into one governed place, and put agents to work on it. Most planning platforms were built for a finance team to manage and maintain by hand, with AI added later. Abacum was built for AI to do the work from day one, so finance can steer the business every week instead of reporting on it every quarter.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities . Headquartered in New York , we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex , and hundreds more.

sections.title: About Abacum
paras: We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners , with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator , Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.
Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

sections.title: About the Role
bullets: Own end-to-end delivery of Abacum implementation projects, from pre-sales scoping through kickoff and delivery, driving customers to success and value realization on the platform.
Partner with Sales during the pre-sales cycle to scope projects, size effort, and present and walk clients through the SOW, setting the right expectations before the deal closes.
Build project documents, sprint plans, budgets, and resource plans tailored to project and delivery model.
Manage implementations that involve both direct customer delivery and delivery through partners, holding partners to the same quality bar as internal delivery.
Manage scope, risk, and change control, escalating early using our governance processes.
Act as the trusted advisor to client stakeholders; not just running the plan, advising on process and org changes needed to get value from the platform.
Coordinate with Product, Support, Sales, Customer Success, and delivery partners to keep a single, coherent client experience.
Get hands-on with the product itself, deep enough to unblock the team on platform or FP&A concept questions without escalating.

sections.title: What You Bring
bullets: 4+ years of hands-on experience implementing a financial planning/EPM platform ; this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
Experience scoping projects pre-sale and presenting SOWs directly to clients, comfortable being in the room before the deal is signed, not just after handoff.
Direct experience managing implementations delivered through third-party partners or resellers, alongside those delivered directly to customers.
Working knowledge of FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, reporting, consolidation), enough to challenge a client's assumptions, not just document them.
Working knowledge of other planning use cases such as workforce planning and others is a bonus.
Track record managing multi-stakeholder, multi-workstream projects with both technical and change-management components.
Ability to read a scope document critically and flag risk before it becomes a delivery problem.
Proficiency with SaaS project tools and Agile/hybrid methodologies.

sections.title: Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters
paras: To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. ashby:applied:aa4c40d9-500f-42a7-b03a-f9.summary: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. You'll own hardware products end to end — from component and architecture decisions through production launch — across the automotive, trucking, defense, construction, mining, and agriculture industries. This is an important role where you will drive both strategy and execution, working closely with engineering, supply chain, and OEM customers to ship hardware that performs reliably in the field.

Partner with business development and marketing on customer pitches, go-to-market positioning, and pricing for hardware products
Work directly with OEM customers to gather feedback and ensure the product roadmap stays aligned with real-world production and deployment needs
Partner with program management and operations to track hardware milestones, costs, and quality through the full product lifecycle

bullets: 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with a focus on hardware products
Experience at an automotive, trucking, defense, or other OEM, or at a supplier building hardware products for them
A track record of shipping hardware products to production, including navigating prototyping, validation, and manufacturing ramp
Strong technical background with understanding of and/or hands-on experience in electrical or mechanical engineering
BS/MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent required
Experience managing external partners, suppliers, or contract manufacturers
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

sections.title: Nice to have:

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. bullets: Experience with sensing platforms (LiDAR, Radar, Cameras), embedded compute, or vehicle integration hardware
Experience working with Tier-1 automotive or defense suppliers

ashby:canals:9a6f4387-aa7f-4fc6-863e-e5d.summary:

Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. ashby:foundationhealthcareers:23d570e2-6.summary:
Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

This role is for someone who thrives in the controlled chaos of an early-stage company — someone who brings structure to ambiguity, builds trust with customers quickly, and gets things done. You'll be the primary point of contact for your customers, the connective tissue between internal teams, and the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

sections.title: Implementation Execution & Delivery
bullets: Lead customer implementations from kickoff through go-live, owning the plan, the timeline, and the outcome
Execute against established implementation methodology and playbooks, contributing improvements as you learn what works

sections.title: What we're building
paras: We've extended Meter's hardware, firmware, and infrastructure platforms to include Ethernet top-of-rack and spine switching.

Paired with Meter's end-to-end delivery model, customers get one accountable operator instead of a stitched-together stack of vendors — the team that designs the hardware also writes the OS, builds the monitoring software, and runs the deployment. Pricing is tied to power consumption, which is how businesses actually buy data center capacity today. Learn more about our approach to automation at meter.ai .

sections.title: What success looks like
bullets: Work directly in the weeds with firmware and backend engineers on control plane design, API design, and observability — reviewing designs, reading code, and debugging alongside them, not just setting direction from a roadmap doc.

Weigh in on hardware tradeoffs when they intersect with software (port density, thermal limits affecting firmware behavior), leaning on our hardware team's expertise rather than owning that judgment yourself.
Help build the hiring plan and start assembling the engineering team responsible for the control plane, APIs, optics, and observability these switches depend on.
Talking to prospective data center customers — enterprises standing up GPU clusters, not hyperscalers — about what they actually need and where the market is underserved.
Staying current on data center networking research and bringing it back to Meter's engineering teams before it becomes a problem they hit blind.

sections.title: Where this role can take you
paras: As Meter's Data Center line grows past its first TOR and spine switches, this role grows into leading a larger product and engineering organization for the business — the same trajectory our switching and firewall product lines are on today.

sections.title: Who you are
bullets: You've built and shipped the firmware or software side of a data center networking platform, ideally as an engineer earlier in your career, and you've seen how control plane design, API design, and observability decisions play out in real deployments — not just in a spec.

You know enough hardware to have an informed opinion — ASIC capabilities, port speed, power and thermal limits — but you're not trying to out-argue the hardware team on their own turf. You'll lean on them and learn the rest on the job.
You'd rather be in the firmware repo or an incident channel with an engineer than in endless planning meetings. Low ego and you’ll roll up your sleeves to win.
You bring engineering teams into alignment without needing formal authority. Hardware, firmware, and software leads treat you as a peer, not a checkpoint — and they trust what you tell them.
You think in systems and sequence work in the right order, so the team isn't relearning the same lesson twice.
You're known in the data center networking community — people you'd want to hire will recognize your name, and you're ambitious enough to want to scale something with them.

ashby:promise:bb3391c2-4d1e-4e48-a9fe-5e.summary:
Promise modernizes how government agencies and utilities support people in financial difficulty. We build technology that makes it simple for residents to receive benefits, engage with assistance programs, set up flexible payment plans, and stay on track—while helping agencies increase efficiency, recover revenue, and deliver services with dignity. Our mission is to transform public systems so they work better for everyone, especially the most vulnerable.

Our team includes experts from companies like Palantir, Google, Stripe , and esteemed government leaders. We work hard and believe deeply in what we do. We're looking for excellent people to build innovative, resilient technology.

sections.title: Company Overview
paras: Backed by over $50 million in funding from top investors – such as Reid Hoffman, Howard Schultz, Michael Seibel, Y Combinator, 8VC, The General Partnership, First Round Capital, Kapor Capital, XYZ Ventures, and Bronze Investments – Promise has been recognized as one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies of 2022,” “Forbes Next Billion-Dollar Startups 2024,” and Y Combinator’s #1 GovTech startup.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: You will be the person who knows what is actually happening with our accounts: where adoption is strong, where it is stalling, where the political winds are shifting, and where there is room to expand and upsell.

You will work directly with senior stakeholders inside utility companies, and municipal agencies, alongside our internal Product, Sales, Outreach, and Implementation teams. Your job is to make sure our customers get real value from Promise, and to make sure Promise never misses a signal that could turn into churn risk or expansion opportunity.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Drive adoption. Monitor usage and engagement across your accounts. Identify where adoption is lagging and build the plan to fix it before it becomes a renewal problem.

Spot and drive expansion. Flag opportunities where an account is ready for a larger footprint and more Promise services, whether that's more programs, more departments, or a broader contract. Build the business case and hand it to Sales to close, then stay in the room as the customer's advocate.

Manage the handoff, both ways. Take over account relationships from the Sales team as implementation happens and stabilizes. When an account expands into new commercial territory, new pricing, or a new deployment, partner with the Implementation team for that phase and pick it back up once things are live again.

Close the loop with Product. Collect and prioritize product feedback from customers and route it back to the Product team with context, not just a list of complaints. Help Product understand why something matters to a customer and what problem it would solve, not just what the feature request was.

Manage renewal risk. Proactively track account health and get ahead of risk signals. If something is not working, say so internally, early, and clearly. Recruit help so that we can intervene and fix things.
Represent Promise in the room. Run regular business reviews with customer stakeholders. Come prepared. Never walk in cold. Take notes and report out with clear tasks and timelines.
Feed the institutional knowledge base. What you learn in the field belongs to the whole company. Document it and share it so the next person does not have to relearn it.

sections.title: What will help you succeed
bullets: You track the context of the client. You can read where a decision really sits and who has to say yes before anything moves. You staff the utility decision maker appropriately, helping them move to contact renewals and upsells. You understand what is important to them and you put that information in front of them.
Experience owning account health outcomes — renewal risk, adoption, or expansion — for a portfolio of large, complex customers.

You use data to make an argument, not to fill a slide. You can pull adoption and throughput numbers, figure out what is actually driving them, and turn that into a specific plan with a named owner and a date.
Willingness to travel up to 20–30% to be on site with customers. Some of the most important conversations in this role happen in-person.

ashby:rain:3f62d2db-7df1-4ced-8899-bfef3.summary: Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

sections.title: Our Ethos
paras: We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

sections.title: What we're looking for
paras: Rain is looking for a Sales Engineer, in this role, you’ll work closely with our business development team, and our engineering team to help prospects deeply understand Rain’s capabilities, scope technical fit, and move quickly from interest to deployment.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role that blends product knowledge, customer empathy, and communication skills. You’ll be a critical bridge between our customers and our technical roadmap, and will shape how we scale sales engineering as Rain grows.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Partner with Business Development team to lead product demos, build proof-of-concepts, and answer in-depth technical and operational questions from prospects.
Serve as the product and infrastructure expert in sales conversations
Collaborate with product and engineering to provide structured customer feedback and influence roadmap decisions.
Work directly with prospective customers to model integrations
Create technical content and resources to enable our Business Development and Customer Support teams, including solution diagrams, data architecture docs, and integration walkthroughs.

sections.title: What you will bring to Rain
bullets: 3+ years as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or Implementation Specialist at a fast-growing SaaS company.
You’re comfortable explaining complex products to both technical and non-technical audiences.
You love working directly with customers and solving real business problems through software.
You have experience integrating with financial systems
You thrive in early-stage environments where you can build processes from scratch.

ashby:ramp:814edb3c-fa7a-452f-bde6-91daa.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About The Role
paras: The next chapter of Ramp's growth runs straight through the customers we already have: 80,000+ finance teams who adopted us for one thing and haven't yet seen what the rest of the platform can do for them. Account Management owns that opportunity - and this role owns the team building the motion to capture it.

You'll lead a group of 5-8 Account Managers, each carrying a book of ~3,000 emerging and SMB customers with real latitude over how they grow it. This is a build role, not a maintain role: the playbooks, coaching systems, and performance bar you set are the ones this team runs on next year. Your ceiling is set by how well you turn individual AM judgment into a repeatable, scalable motion that grows the segment.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Build and run a high-performing team of 5-8 Account Managers - setting the bar for culture, morale, and daily execution.
Understand where to prioritize your teams time. Engage directly with AMs to identify and break into top accounts, especially where trust is being built or repaired.

Own the number. Manage quota performance and pipeline generation across your team to hit spend activation, product activation, retention, and expansion goals. Forecast your business to senior leadership on a weekly cadence.
Hire and develop the next generation of AMs - training on product, buyer personas, competition, and tooling through role-plays, game film, and real deal work.
Coach relentlessly. Run daily 1:1s, dissect call feedback, lead enablement sessions, and build career paths for every rep on your team.
Turn what works into a system. Continuously refine team processes and tooling to improve output and efficiency as the segment scales.
Represent Account Management cross-functionally, partnering with Sales, CX, CSM, Risk, and Product to remove blockers and drive outcomes.

sections.title: What You’ll Need
bullets: Minimum 2+ years of quota-carrying sales or account management experience as an individual contributor, with a proven, consistent track record of exceeding goals (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)
Minimum 1+ years building and leading account management or sales teams, with a track record of exceeding goal (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)
Prior success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS or AI companies
A genuine passion for hiring, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and development
Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value to customers, including executive leaders
Proficiency with data analytics tools (Salesforce, Looker, Excel) and a bias toward using data to drive decisions
Strong collaboration and influencing skills, backed by excellent communication and presentation ability
High agency and adaptability - no two days are the same, and the only constant is change

ashby:sciforium:ef60d411-6f56-4afb-8598-.summary: Sciforium is an AI infrastructure company developing next-generation multimodal AI models and a proprietary, high-efficiency serving platform. Backed by multi-million-dollar funding and direct sponsorship from AMD with hands-on support from AMD engineers the team is scaling rapidly to build the full stack powering frontier AI models and real-time applications.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: Sciforium is seeking a Product Marketing Manager with a technical background to work between our engineering team and the market. In this role, you will own how our model serving platform, API and model launches reach developers and AI teams, from positioning and technical content to launches and posts on X.
You will also work as a product manager with our engineers. You will bring in what customers and the market need, write product requirements and help decide what we build next.

You will work directly with the CEO, ship much of the work yourself and run programs end-to-end, from the first idea to the results. This role is ideal for someone with both product management and product marketing experience who has grown an audience on X in the AI space.

sections.title: WHAT YOU'LL DO
bullets: Product Marketing : Own positioning and messaging for our model serving platform, API and model launches. Write the go-to-market plan for each release and run it end-to-end, from the first idea to the post-launch numbers.

Product Management : Work with engineering on what we build next. Gather feedback from users, sales calls and the market, turn it into product requirements and feature specs, prioritize them with the team, and follow each feature through release and adoption.
Technical Content : Write blogs, launch posts and benchmark write-ups with our engineers. Explain inference performance, GPU kernels and model serving in plain technical English that engineers trust.

SEO, GEO and AEO : Make Sciforium show up when people search Google or ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity about AI inference. Plan the content, structure the pages, and track where we rank and where we get cited.

X and Socia l: Grow the reach of Sciforium and our leadership on X, where the AI community talks. Spot the debates and trends worth joining that day, and turn engineering results into threads, clips and posts that people share.

Programs : Launch programs end-to-end, from idea to execution, including launch campaigns, creator collaborations, developer programs and events. Set the goal, build the plan, ship the assets and measure the result. Sales Enablement: Write the one-pagers, decks and comparison sheets our sales team uses with customers.

sections.title: IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
3+ years of experience across product marketing and product management at an AI, developer tools or infrastructure company.
5+ years for senior candidates. Product management experience: you have written product requirements, worked with engineers from spec to release, and measured how a feature was adopted.
Technical depth: you can read a benchmark, ask engineers the right questions and explain the answer correctly.
Product Marketing Manager (job description draft) 2 A proven track record on X in the AI space: accounts you grew and posts or threads that reached a large audience. Please include links.
Hands-on experience creating content with AI video, image and voice tools, and comfortable both on camera and behind it.
Strong technical writing. Please include samples.
Working knowledge of SEO and of how AI assistants choose the sources they cite (GEO, AEO).

sections.title: NICE-TO-HAVE
bullets: Prior work as a product manager or engineer on a developer-facing or APIfirst product. Familiarity with LLM inference, GPUs, open-weight model releases, or inference engines like vLLM and SGLang.
Experience at an early-stage startup, or as one of the first marketing hires.
Experience running paid social or search campaigns.
Video editing skills (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, CapCut or similar).
Working fluency with Webflow, GA4, HubSpot, Figma and Canva.
An existing network of AI creators and developers

ashby:serval:341ba017-8b4b-4560-afa9-fde.summary:
Serval is the AI-native enterprise service management platform that automates the work legacy IT service management tools only track. Our AI agents build the automations that power employee support, then resolve requests against them instantly—helping teams across IT, HR, finance, legal, and beyond automate work within one governed platform.

Companies including Fox, Live Nation, Notion, Ramp, and Lucid Motors run on Serval. Headquartered in San Francisco, we’ve raised $277 million from investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, First Round, General Catalyst, and Elad Gil, most recently a $150 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation.

sections.title: Who We Are
paras: We’re building a team that moves quickly, takes ownership, and wants to make a meaningful impact on how the world’s largest organizations work. Come help us build what’s next for enterprise service management.

sections.title: Role Overview
paras: This role will be part of our founding Solutions Engineer team: the first technical seller at Serval and the person who defines what world-class solutions architecture looks like here. You'll own the technical side of the pre-sales cycle for prospective strategic customers, sitting across the table from sophisticated IT and security buyers who test every claim we make. Your job is to earn their trust, prove the platform, and win the technical decision. Because you're first, you're not inheriting a playbook, you're writing it: partnering directly with our GTM leaders and account executives, shaping how we demo and run technical evaluations, and building the technical foundation the next ten SAs will use.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: A builder at heart, able to scope what matters, stand up a demo or proof-of-value yourself, and ship it.
Deeply technical and credible, the kind of person who earns the respect of CIOs, Heads of IT, and security leaders in the first meeting.
A trusted advisor by instinct, who listens for the real problem and proves value in the sales cycle rather than pitching features.
Living on the AI frontier, fluent in how agents and LLM-powered systems get deployed and governed inside the enterprise.
Comfortable in ambiguity, owning your work end-to-end, and moving without waiting to be told what to build next.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Run the technical sales motion with AEs: discovery, architecture, demos, whiteboard sessions, executive briefings, and the security review that wins technical buy-in.
Go deep on integrations with the prospect's stack, including identity providers (Okta, Entra), ITSM and ticketing, MDM, HRIS, cloud, and the SaaS apps Serval provisions against.
Translate unique technical environments, requirements, and goals into a scoped set of value-based use cases and success criteria for pilot.
Be the credible voice on security and access, fluent in guardrails, approval workflows, least-privilege and just-in-time access, audit logging, and the compliance questions security teams press on.
Execute a clean handoff to Deployment at pilot kickoff, with full technical context, then roll off the account.
Build the foundational SA toolkit from scratch: demo environments, reference architectures, evaluation frameworks, technical FAQs, and competitive positioning.
Act as the bridge between the field and product, capturing the hardest objections and feature gaps and working directly with engineering to close them.

ashby:sierra:66324233-f3af-496a-b43d-ebe.summary:
Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Sierra is growing fast, and product marketing sits at the center of how we go to market. You'll make sure customers and prospects understand what we build, why it matters to their industry and role, and why Sierra is the right choice. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, sales enablement, and content, working closely with product, sales, agent development and the rest of marketing.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Shape how we tell our story. You’re a passionate product marketer, energized by messaging and positioning and skilled at building a message for a feature, product, industry or buyer. One day you may update web copy, the next you build an event session, craft a sales narrative, write a launch blog post, or create content for a campaign.

Lead product launches. When a product or new feature ships, you lead how we go to market - the messaging, the assets, and the sales enablement. Sometimes this means translating to industries or buyers.
Arm our sales team. You build and maintain the playbooks and assets our GTM teams use to sell including slide decks, landing pages, demos and more.

Build with AI-first. You’re AI fluent, and your first instinct is to self-serve and improve how you work. You’ll help build the automations, templates, and systems that keep our work consistent across industries and workstreams.

Go wide and deep. You flex across channels and activations, and you can go deep on one area, such as an industry vertical, a persona, or our web strategy. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace, and you like to build.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: 4+ years of B2B or B2C product marketing experience.
Expertise in positioning and messaging, leading product or feature launches, and building sales-facing and customer-facing assets for different audiences and industries.
Strong operational instincts. You think in process, systems, and repeatable frameworks, and you’re comfortable building structure where none exists.
Fluency with tools like ChatGPT or Claude to work faster and automate where it makes sense.
A passion for storytelling and experience building presentations in Google Slides.
Comfort being on a lean team that’s still being defined, and enthusiasm for shaping how it works.

sections.title: Sample Projects
bullets: Take a new product from roadmap to launch: positioning, messaging, sales assets, enablement, and demo.
Go deep on an industry and understand how our product can help that segment, build messaging that resonates, and downstream assets.

ashby:socure:055da1d9-4664-4921-9787-642.summary:
Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Socure's Watchlist screening and monitoring platform — a foundational product in our compliance suite serving a rapidly growing customer base.

You will own the roadmap and strategy for our market-leading Watchlist Screening and Monitoring product, which enables banks, fintechs, gaming companies, and more around the world manage their sanctions and AML risk.
You will work closely with Data Science, Engineering, and go-to-market teams to build a market leading product and drive growth.

sections.title: WHAT YOU'LL DO
bullets: Own the Watchlist product roadmap, balancing compliance accuracy, customer needs, and engineering capacity.
Translate market trends, regulatory changes, and customer feedback into product priorities and requirements.
Define and track key product metrics: screening accuracy, false positive rates, match coverage, and customer outcomes.
Drive improvements to Watchlist's core individual screening and monitoring capabilities, including name match accuracy and data coverage.
Work with Engineering to evolve the platform's scalability, reliability, and integration with Socure's broader product suite.
Work with data science to build our next generation data ingestion technology to improve the accuracy of our watchlist data.
Develop and maintain machine learning systems that keep our patented real-time matching engine at the highest levels of recall and precision.
Collaborate with Engineering, Data Science, and Compliance Ops to translate requirements into executable plans.

sections.title: WHAT YOU BRING
paras: You must be located in one of our talent hubs: New York, San Francisco, Seattle, or Miami.
bullets: Experience: 3–5 years in product management, preferably in compliance technology, AML/sanctions screening, identity verification, or ML-driven products.
Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with AML/BSA regulations, sanctions screening workflows, or financial crime compliance is strongly preferred.
Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of APIs, data pipelines, and ML model behavior; comfortable reviewing technical specs and writing SQL.
Analytical Skills: Ability to evaluate screening performance metrics (recall, precision, hit rate) and translate them into product decisions.
Customer Focus: Experience working directly with compliance buyers, financial institutions, or enterprise customers in complex environments.
Communication: Ability to explain technical or compliance concepts clearly to engineering partners, compliance buyers, and executive stakeholders.
Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, and go-to-market teams in a fast-paced environment.

ashby:synthesia:103ca468-012b-4882-b5ab-.summary:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function in North America. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building while scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.
This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across North America.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia’s business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.
Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia’s platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value.
Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.
Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.
Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.
Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.
Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

sections.title: We’d love to hear from you if you have
bullets: 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).
Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).
Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer’s use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.
Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.
Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.
Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.
Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.
Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

sections.title: We’d be particularly excited if
bullets: You have previous experience as an AE.
You have experience with video AI.

ashby:taaraconnect:3322dff3-5add-4caf-91.summary:
Taara extends and amplifies global communications infrastructure using beams of light to deliver high-speed connectivity. Born at X, Google’s moonshot factory, Taara works with enterprise customers, Physical AI companies, and fiber operators, and internal teams to plan, deploy, and operate optical wireless networks around the world.

As Taara scales deployments and evolves its software products, we are looking for a Product Manager, Software Products to shape and improve the User Experience (UX) across all customer facing product surfaces.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: This role will own and evolve Taara's software products across customer-facing applications and embedded terminal software. You will work closely with engineering, UX design, Customer Success, and users to translate customer needs into clear technical product requirements, prioritize improvements, and deliver an integrated software experience. The ideal candidate combines strong software technical knowledge with business judgment and the ability to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines.

Success in this role means delivering a cohesive software product experience across Taara's customer-facing applications and embedded systems. You will define clear product requirements, identify dependencies and integration risks, and partner with engineering to prioritize features, reliability improvements, and customer-impacting issues. You will use customer feedback, product telemetry, and measurable outcomes to guide decisions and continuously improve software quality and user experience.

sections.title: How you will make 10x impact:
bullets: Own the product scope, requirements, and prioritization across Taara's customer-facing software applications and embedded terminal software.
Translate customer and internal needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Drive product road mapping by defining priorities, sequencing releases, and aligning stakeholders on what to build next and why.
Partner closely with engineering and UX design to deliver features that balance technical feasibility, usability, and business outcomes.
Work with customers and internal teams to understand real-world use cases, gather feedback, and prioritize enhancements.
Collaborate with marketing, sales, and customer success to support product launches, enablement, and adoption.
Help shape and validate analysis, reporting, and visualization features, including exploration of AI-assisted workflows where appropriate.
Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify customer needs, evaluate software capabilities, and inform product features and roadmap priorities.

sections.title: What you should have:
bullets: 5+ years of product management experience delivering technically complex software products, with demonstrated ability to work closely with software engineering teams on architecture, system dependencies, and product requirements.

Experience translating customer and technical requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, and prioritized backlogs, with an understanding of software integrations and system-level dependencies.
Strong technical understanding of software products, with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams on technical requirements, integrations, and dependencies.
Ability to conduct user interviews and synthesize insights into clear product direction.
Comfort working cross-functionally with engineering, UX, and customer-facing teams.
Experience using data, feedback, or product signals to inform prioritization and iteration.
Experience using customer feedback, product telemetry, software quality metrics, and business priorities to guide product decisions and measure improvements.
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain product decisions clearly to diverse stakeholders.

Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

Familiarity with technical systems, infrastructure products, or complex workflows is a plus.

Experience managing B2B SaaS products or platforms with frequent software releases.
Comfort operating in startup environments and managing ambiguity.

ashby:tenex:f3249f96-07d2-40d9-ab63-1c16.summary:
TENEX is an AI-native, automation-first, built-for-scale Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider. We are a force multiplier for defenders, helping organizations enhance their cybersecurity posture through advanced threat detection, rapid response, and continuous protection. Our team is composed of industry experts with deep experience in cybersecurity, automation and AI-driven solutions. Backed by leading investors, we are rapidly growing and seeking top talent to join our mission of revolutionizing the AI-Native MDR landscape.

We’re a fast growing startup backed by industry experts and top tier investors led by Crosspoint Capital Partners and also backed by Shield Capital, DTCP (formerly Deutsche Telekom Capital Partners), Deepwork Capital, and the Florida Opportunity Fund. Seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As an early employee, you’ll play a meaningful role in…

sections.title: Company Overview:
paras: Culture is one of the most important things at TENEX.AI —explore our culture deck at culture.tenex.ai to witness how we embody it, prioritizing the irreplaceable collaboration and community of in-person work.

The ideal candidate will be able to work a hybrid in office schedule in our Overland Park,KS or Sarasota, FL office. TENEX will offer a paid relocation package for those open to relocation to either location.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: The Manager, Customer Success Operations owns the operating system beneath our post-sales organization — the data, tooling, voice-of-customer signal, and operating cadence that let Customer Success, the Rapid Deployment Team, and Professional Services run on facts instead of anecdote.

Where a Customer Success Manager owns the customer relationship and an Engagement Manager owns a scoped engagement, the CS Operations Manager owns the machine: the reporting and dashboards leadership runs on, the Customer Success platform the team works in every day, the health-scoring model, the survey programs that tell us how we're doing, and the systems that keep our data trustworthy. It's a builder-operator role — you'll define requirements, build or configure the system, roll it out, and then own it in production.

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and…

sections.title: Background
paras: We’ve spent the last two years getting ahead in AI and our customers see it. It’s showing up in our product, our pace of innovation, and our gross margin. Now we’re putting centralized firepower behind it.

We’re launching two teams: Applied AI, focused on transforming how work gets done, and AI Platform, building the tools and infrastructure to scale it. Together, they’ll sharpen how we measure impact, deploy tooling, and set expectations across Engine, taking what’s already a competitive advantage and making it our operating advantage.

sections.title: Your Mission
paras: You'll build the automation that powers how Engine runs behind the scenes. This is internal tooling, not a consumer-facing product. The goal is to make teams across the business dramatically faster and more scalable. As an embedded Product Manager on the Applied AI team, you'll sit inside one of Engine's business functions. You'll find the manual steps that slow the work down and get them automated. Here's what you'll own:
bullets: Map the work: Shadow the people doing the work and map each step, handoff and wait, so you know where the time goes.

Pick the workload: Take on one workload at a time, starting with the steps that are repetitive, high-volume and the most time-consuming. You and the functional leader decide what goes next, and you say no to the rest.
Lock the metric: Before anything gets built, get the functional leader to sign off on a cycle time or unit metric, and measure the baseline.

Build and ship: Work with engineering to design and ship automation that replaces manual work at Engine's scale, which includes hundreds of thousands of support cases. Use AI tools and agents to speed up your own analysis, prototyping and documentation.
Scope and roll out: Define the first version you can ship, who uses it first and how it reaches the rest of the function.
Hand it off: Define what it looks like for the function to run the workload without you, with a named owner inside the function.
Make the kill call: If the metric doesn't move, come back with a fix or a decision to stop, with a deadline.

sections.title: What You'll Bring to Engine
paras: We're looking for someone who's ready to make an impact and grow alongside us:
bullets: Experience: 4+ years in product management, ideally on internal tools, operations or workflow products, with at least one AI or automation product in production.
Process instincts: You've mapped a messy business process, found the steps that cost the most time and removed them.
Operator comfort: You're happy spending your first weeks shadowing support agents or accountants, and you judge success by whether the work got faster.
Measurement: You can baseline a cycle time, define a metric a business leader will sign off on, and account for the costs, including model spend and engineering time.
AI fluency: You understand what LLMs and agents do well, where they fail, and how evals and human review fit into a workflow.
Influence: You earn trust with leaders who don't report to you, and you hold the line on scope when everyone wants something different.

sections.title: Success in the First Six Months
paras: Applications for this role will be accepted through 12/20/2026 until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process. If your expectations fall outside the range, please apply anyway. We'd love to talk.

bullets: The function's key workflows are mapped, showing where the time goes.

Diagnose customer-specific issues by tracing data flows, validating assumptions, reviewing technical evidence, and isolating root causes.
Resolve issues directly when they fall within your scope; when they don't, escalate through Support or Solutions Engineering with clear context, evidence, impact, and recommended next steps.
Stay accountable through resolution, keeping Customer Performance informed and translating technical findings into clear customer-facing guidance.
Create reusable health checks, documentation, and runbooks, and surface recurring patterns that should be standardized, productized, or addressed through process improvements.

Technical fluency across data flows, integrations, APIs, web tracking, ecommerce infrastructure, and the pipelines that move and transform customer data.

Clear written and verbal communication, especially the ability to explain technical findings, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong collaboration instincts and comfort working in lockstep with Customer Performance while coordinating across Support, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering.

sections.title: YOUR IMPACT
paras: RunMyJobs by Redwood is the orchestration layer for enterprise workloads, and it is already the standard for SAP. Win The Cloud is the roadmap pillar that extends that position to everything else a modern enterprise runs: workloads on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, hybrid estates that mix cloud services with systems built over twenty years, and the data and DevOps pipelines that connect them. As Lead Product Manager, you own the strategy and execution of this pillar as a product line. The mandate is to turn a catalog of cloud connectors into a small number of cloud use cases that customers recognize, that our field can sell, and that cloud buyers choose us for. You will report to the VP, Product Management for RunMyJobs and work as a peer with the SAP pillar owner on the boundary between SAP and non-SAP workloads.

The role carries both sides of the problem. On the product side, you set the connector and platform priorities that deliver credible hyperscaler parity and the capabilities cloud and platform engineering teams expect. On the market side, you write the use cases, shape the pricing and packaging inputs, and work with Product Marketing, Sales and Alliances so the story reaches cloud buyers. You will start by leading the product side of our AWS relationship and the cloud use-case work, and you will grow the pillar's team and scope as the business case earns investment.
The following attributes are key to excelling in this role:
bullets: Working-Backwards Use-Case Craft: Writes the customer outcome first, in a PR/FAQ or equivalent, and turns it into a use case with a clear buyer, problem and business value that Product Marketing can convert into messaging and the field can sell. You replace connector lists with plays.

Customer Discovery and Experience: Runs structured discovery with cloud buyers and users, and designs the product experience as well as the requirements. Product design or UX depth is an advantage in a pillar where the experience of orchestrating cloud services is part of the value.

Portfolio Judgment: Makes trade-offs across connectors, platform capabilities and use cases competing for the same engineering capacity, can name what was deliberately not built, and manages dependencies across several engineering teams.

Partner and Ecosystem Awareness: Leads the product side of a hyperscaler partnership track and knows how a cloud provider's service teams and field decide which partners to support. Helps determine where Azure and Google Cloud justify dedicated investment.
Commercial Ownership: Treats the pillar as a business. Builds the market baseline and expected return, owns the leading indicators (non-SAP adoption, pipeline, win/loss), and reports them honestly.

Mentoring and Influence: Raises the craft of the product managers and product owners around you through coaching, templates and example, and influences engineering, marketing, sales and executives without formal authority.

AI-First Practice: Uses AI in your own work and can show where it belongs in product management, including the cloud-and-AI story for orchestrating non-deterministic AI inside deterministic business processes.

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

sections.title: Who We Are
paras: You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software.

Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting.

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person.

sections.title: The access model and administrator interfaces: get the core concepts right
bullets: Own users, groups, credentials, access levels, door associations, and schedules. This is the conceptual core of the product, and getting it right is the difference between an admin who trusts the system and one who works around it
Own the administrative interfaces and experience across web and mobile: bulk operations, search, and review flows that stay fast when a customer has 200,000 users and 10,000 doors
Own visitor access, including how guests are invited, credentialed, and expired

sections.title: Provisioning and integrations: let the system run itself
bullets: Own the API and integration surface. Most large customers want access to follow their identity provider and HR system automatically, so joiners, movers, and leavers are handled without anyone touching our UI
Partner with Verkada's Core team to drive identity integration: SCIM provisioning, SSO, directory sync, and the mapping between an HR record and what a door actually does

WithCoverage replaces the traditional insurance brokerage with AI-supercharged risk management designed for the modern economy.

Our in-house Agency Management System gives our team and AI agents full visibility into policies, exposures, claims, billing, and commissions. This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.

sections.title: About WithCoverage :
paras: WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound). We have raised over $50M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.
Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.

sections.title: We are open to a wide range of levels for this role.
paras: We serve hundreds of clients, and a lot of the work behind that is still done by hand: certificates of insurance, carrier back-and-forth, contract redlines, claims follow-ups. As a Product Manager on our R&D team, you’ll turn complex operational workflows into simple, effective products.

You’ll spend much of your time close to the people doing the work: sitting with teams, understanding where processes break down, identifying where software and AI can create leverage, and translating that understanding into clear product improvements.

You’ll also help us mature how we build products as a company. We are moving from an early, highly scrappy environment toward a team that can maintain that speed while developing stronger product discipline around scoping, measurement, prioritization, and iteration.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Turn operational pain into product . Spend real time with risk advisors, ops and clients. Do the manual work yourself to understand the decisions, edge cases and workarounds a useful solution needs to handle.

Find the biggest wins. Identify the problems worth solving first based on business impact, user needs and implementation effort. Turn a messy workflow into a clear problem, a focused first version and explicit criteria for whether it works.

Build the first version. Use AI tools and our internal tooling to prototype and build a working V1. Work with engineering to decide what you can ship independently and what needs further development or hardening.
Own the outcome. From the first conversation with the ops team to a shipped fix you can measure. If it doesn't change how the work gets done, it isn't finished.
Measure what changed. Know before you start how you'll tell whether it worked, and use the results to decide whether to keep going or move on.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: You start with the business problem. Before you build anything, you can explain what it's for, who it helps and how you'll know it worked.
You've owned a messy problem end to end. You've taken an operational or product problem and made it measurably better, and you can walk through what you did, the tradeoffs you made and what changed.
You have strong product judgment. You know how to scope a focused first version, prioritize by impact and effort, and use results to decide whether to keep going or move on.
You build with AI. You don't need to write production code, but you've used AI tools to ship something real, like an automation, an internal tool or a prototype people actually used.
You work well close to the work. You build trust with ops teams and risk advisors, ask the questions other people skip, and partner with engineering on what's ready to ship and what needs more work.
You learn fast. You can get up to speed on an unfamiliar domain quickly and get to the root of a problem.
You have a few years of experience solving real operational or product problems. Your title matters less than what you've built and fixed.

lever:angellist:4cd1232d-979e-4d37-82e9-.summary:
Private markets are the new public markets. The most important companies of this era are private, and almost no one can own them. What's missing is the financial system public markets spent a century building: exchanges, custodians, brokers, and ways for ordinary people to buy in. Private markets, now $28T, never had the equivalent. AngelList is building it.

The last decade of structural innovation in venture happened here: syndicates, SPVs at scale, Rolling Funds, scout programs. Today we have $200B+ in assets and 30,000+ startups funded on our platform. The rest of private markets is next. Funds is the software and services behind private funds, Nova is the banking network, Meridian is the wealth platform for accredited investors, and USVC is the brand behind a registered fund that lets anyone invest in venture.

A fund administrator run by agents. Agents handle accounting, reconciliation, capital calls, and investor requests, people step in only on genuine exceptions. You are directly responsible for making that a reality.
The default on Institutional Venture. Institutional is one of our fastest-growing products and wins most of the deals it competes for. Your job is to make it the obvious choice for established firms.

bullets: Own the roadmap for our Institutional product. Decide which fund operations workflows to automate next, from bank reconciliation to journal entries to LP requests, and shape how CFOs and finance teams work alongside agents.

Talk to customers constantly. From managing partners to fund CFOs and controllers, turn what you hear into a sharp product point of view, and be in the room when a deal is being won or a relationship needs repair.
Grow revenue, assets under administration, and retention by building a product that is accurate, responsive, and efficient enough that customers recommend us to their peers.
Make switching to AngelList easy by turning migrations from incumbent administrators into a fast, predictable experience.
Write product requirements that turn complex accounting, tax, and operational realities into work engineering and design can ship.
Partner with sales, fund accounting, and operations to win new firms and keep existing ones successful.

bullets: Have built something from early to scale. You have taken a B2B product from a handful of customers to more than a hundred, as a founder or an early product leader, and you have owned the revenue that came with it.

Fluency in fund operations (capital calls, capital accounts, NAV, K-1s, audits) is a plus. If you are not there yet, you have learned a domain this complex quickly before.
Build with AI every day. You use AI tools to prototype, analyze, and ship. You know where they still fall short when every number has to be right.
Design for trust. Finance teams adopt automation only when they can check it. You care about accuracy, auditability, and knowing exactly when a person needs to step in.
Are at-home with demanding customers. You can earn the confidence of managing partners and CFOs, present the product in a sales meeting, and turn an escalation into a better roadmap.
Own outcomes, not just roadmaps. You do whatever the product and the customer need to win, working closely with engineering, sales, and operations.

The Client Service Representative manages communication between the laboratory and clients to

ensure expectations are met, assists clients in submitting needed information, managing sample receipt

and registration, and other activities as needed to maintain good client relations.

sections.title: Authority
paras:
The Client Service Representative receives sufficient authority from, and is accountable to, the Client

Services Supervisor, or appointed designate, for the successful completion of assigned duties and

responsibilities and has the authority to take action necessary to carry out the duties and

responsibilities of this position and to identify the occurrence of departures from the quality system or

from the procedures for performing tests and/or calibrations, so long as such action does not deviate

from established company guidelines, is consistent with sound technical and business judgment, and

follows the practices of the laboratory.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Responsible for all routine communications between the customer and the laboratory.

2. General clerical duties such as answering phones, processing mail, greeting clients, etc.

3. Routing couriers for sample pickups.

4. Receiving samples from clients via parcel services, couriers and in-person drop off.

5. Confirming and documenting sample conditions on receipt.

6. Provision of sampling supplies as needed to the customer.

7. Responsible for intercompany communication and sample coordination.

8. Clarification of client’s requests for services.

9. Entering new client information into appropriate systems.

10. Registration of incoming samples.

11. Validating sample registration information.

12. Routing of samples and paperwork to appropriate storage locations and analysts within the

laboratory and notification to the analysts if those samples requiring special handling.

13. Creation and Maintenance of Reference Quotations.

14. Schedules, coordinates and participates in client conference calls as needed; attends meetings

with technical groups as needed

15. Assist in management of invoices for client billing.

16. Responsible for managing outsources samples with partner Eurofins laboratories to ensure timely

COA release for clients.

17. Coordinate all out going shipping for ESFA. (samples, returning coolers, Etc.)

18. Creating return shipping labels for clients shipping samples back regularly

19. Scanning/attaching documents to samples or projects in LIMS systems.

20. Responsible for reaching out to customers to collect payment for overdue bills

21. Responsible for submitting results to WDNR for EDD testing.

22. Conducts all activities in a safe and efficient manner

23. Maintain regular attendance and punctuality

24. Performs other duties as assigned

smartrecruiters:ifs1:744000138713339.summary:
We’re building intelligent, autonomous AI agents that can reason, plan, and act across real-world workflows. These agents go beyond chat — they take meaningful action, work across tools and systems, and operate in complex, high-stakes environments.

As our Product Manager , you’ll lead the definition and delivery of early use cases for agentic AI. You’ll turn cutting-edge agent capabilities — like long-term memory, tool use, and planning — into applied, valuable products .

You’ll be use-case–driven, but platform-aware — working closely with engineering and research to ensure what we build is feasible, scalable, and aligned with the underlying agent architecture.

sections.title: Use Case Discovery & Validation
bullets: Identify and prioritize agent use cases with high ROI: operational automation, coordination agents, internal task delegation, etc.
Work with users and stakeholders to understand their workflows, challenges, and trust boundaries.
Prototype and iterate agent behaviors in production-like environments to validate fit and reliability.

sections.title: Product Design & Execution
bullets: Define the agent experience — from delegation to monitoring to escalation — for real-world scenarios.
Translate use cases into clear product specs: user flows, system interactions, prompts, safety requirements, and interfaces.
Own the roadmap and ship iteratively: starting small, learning fast, scaling wisely.

sections.title: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets: Collaborate with engineering to align product needs with agent platform capabilities (planning, memory, tool orchestration, retries, etc.).
Partner with AI research to bring experimental features into real-world settings.
Ensure the platform supports the complexity of applied, multi-step, tool-using agents.

sections.title: Strategy & Metrics
bullets: Define success metrics around outcomes — time saved, accuracy improved, failures recovered — not just clicks or sessions.
Build product foundations that allow for vertical reuse, system generalization, and long-term scalability.
